posts.title: Oil & Gas Asia 2025
posts.excerpt: The Oil & Gas Asia (OGA) 2025 exhibition successfully took place from 2-4 September 2025 at the Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre (KLCC), Malaysia. Celebrating its 21st edition, OGA once again proved to be one of the region's most influential gatherings for the oil, gas, energy, and petrochemical industries. With the theme "Powering Progress, Shaping Tomorrow," this year's event highlighted innovation, sustainability, and digital transformation across the energy sector. More than 2,000 exhibitors and international pavilions from over 70 countries participated, showcasing advanced technologies, equipment, and services driving the industry forward. The event also featured SPEAK OGA, where industry leaders discussed energy transition, net-zero ambitions, and digital solutions shaping the future of global energy.

posts.title: Oil & Gas Asia 2024
posts.excerpt: We were super thrilled to be part of Oil & Gas Asia (OGA) 2024 Exhibition that began on 25th September at the Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre (KLCC), engaging conversations and exchanging ideas with various stakeholders and experts about the services provided by Advantage Marine Services (M) Sdn Bhd. This significant event brought together the Oil & Gas majors and solution providers with innovative and state-of-the-art technology. Over 2,000 companies representing multiple ranges of industries participated in the 20th edition of this event, which ended on 27th September. Aligned with our slogan Discover the AMS Difference, AMS thrives to excel as a preferred one-stop solution provider for underwater and topside Repairs, Inspection and Maintenance, engineering, steel fabrication, Non-Destructive Testing (NDT), and Rope Access for the Oil & Gas, Marine, and Petrochemical industry.
